assumptions: It is an inference that the source and target refer to the same vulnerable Jetson Linux instance and PCI-bus context.
It is an inference that successful memory access would produce any particular takeover consequence; the CVE description states possibilities rather than guaranteed outcomes.

evidence_quotes.quote: an unprivileged attacker with physical access to the board
direct read/write access to the entire system address space through the PCI bus
could result in denial of service, code execution, escalation of privileges, and impact to data integrity and confidentiality
The scope impact may extend to other components.

missing_conditions: Verified physical access to the affected Jetson board
Affected Jetson Nano or Jetson Nano 2GB hardware running a vulnerable Jetson Linux 32.x version prior to 32.7.1
Ability to exercise the vulnerability through the PCI bus
Successful exploitation that actually obtains the described system-address-space read/write capability
Externally verified relationship between the source capability and the target system or state
Evidence that kernel-data overwrite, code execution, privilege escalation, complete denial of service, and compromise of other components occur rather than remain possible outcomes
response.reason: CVE-2022-21819 describes a potential source capability: an unprivileged attacker with physical access may obtain direct read/write access to the entire system address space through the PCI bus. That capability matches the target prerequisite at a high level, so a bounded causal bridge is plausible if the physical-access, affected-platform, PCI-bus, and successful-exploitation conditions are verified. However, the description says the consequences could result and that scope may extend to other components; it does not establish guaranteed kernel-data overwrite, arbitrary or highest-level code execution, complete system takeover, or compromise of adjacent hardware. The edge therefore should not enter a strict graph as an unconditional supported edge; it is conditional on those unverified prerequisites and outcomes.
